evidence.detail: CARDS_BY_NAME is populated with canonical name (front face) and flavor_name aliases only — back face names of transform/DFC cards are never added as keys
add_aliases() only adds printed_name when `printed_name != face['name']` for English cards — for English DFCs the back face printed_name equals the face name so no alias is created for the back face

valid_name() searches CARDS_BY_NAME by exact name, then by text before '/', then by canonicalized match — 'Irencrag' (back face) would not match 'The Irencrag' (front face key) under any of these paths, raising InvalidDataException

triage.fix_sketch: In `magic/oracle.py` inside `init()`, after `CARDS_BY_NAME[c.name] = c`, also index back face names from `c.get('names', '').split('|')[1:]` for cards with two faces — only adding a back-face name if it is not already a key in CARDS_BY_NAME (to avoid overriding front-face entries). This makes back-face names resolvable via `valid_name()` so the bot can look up legality for 'Irencrag' (the equipment form). Also update `decksite/views/seasons.py:19` to use `set(oracle.CARDS_BY_NAME.values())` to avoid overcounting newly-indexed back faces. ~10-15 lines total.
triage.notes: Confidence is medium because the exact internal name of the equipment back face and its runtime behavior in the bot could not be verified without a live DB; however the static code path shows no mechanism exists to look up back face names of English DFCs.
